change_scope._base_sha_basis: No pre-change commit exists: there is NO 212R options strategy implementation on main (strat_212.py = continuation only; daily_strat.py returns NO_TRADE daily_212_reversal_not_in_v1). base_sha deliberately == HEAD so the gate reports 'no change to qualify'.

contract_selection._liquidity_basis: config.py: quality_max_spread_percent 20.0, quality_min_open_interest 500, risk_min_dte_days 14 (constraints enforced by contracts/contract_validator.py evaluate_contract_constraints).
contract_selection._selector_basis: No mechanical contract SELECTOR exists in the repo. evaluate_contract_constraints is a VALIDATOR (accept/reject a supplied contract); nothing chooses expiration/strike/delta. selection_rule_path/sha256 deliberately omitted.
contract_selection._timestamp_basis: audit 09-16: 83/83 journal contracts have bid/ask/OI/vol/IV, 0 have a quote timestamp.

data_integrity._option_quotes_basis: NO option quote dataset exists for 212R episodes (audit 09-16: contract feasibility UNKNOWN for 91% of opportunities; no chain retained unless a candidate reached contract stage; 212R never reaches contract stage). option_quotes_manifest_path/sha256 deliberately omitted.

fill_realism._fill_basis: Describes the ONLY fill model in the repo (options_manager/paper_sim.py, config defaults paper_sim_entry_fill=ASK / paper_sim_exit_fill=BID). ZERO 212R option fills have ever been simulated with it.
fill_realism._max_quote_age_basis: max_quote_age_seconds deliberately omitted: no quote-staleness concept exists (0 quote timestamps).

golden_parity._parity_basis: No 212R fixtures exist. options_manager/replay/fixtures.py covers strat_212 CONTINUATION only.

provenance._policy_basis: No standalone options policy file exists; policy = config.py dataclass defaults + OPTIONS_MANAGER_* env. Hashed at HEAD.

risk_policy._aggregate_basis: validation/portfolio_risk_gate.py evaluate_portfolio_risk: None budget -> blocking (fails closed).
risk_policy._aggregate_budget_basis: config.py default None (OPTIONS_MANAGER_MAX_AGGREGATE_OPEN_RISK_DOLLARS unset in repo defaults; box .env not read for this package).
risk_policy._averaging_basis: no explicit averaging-down guard found in options_manager; left false.
risk_policy._planned_risk_basis: not verified in code for this package; left false.
risk_policy._risk_basis: plans/base.py: premium_stop is a required float; proof_adapter.py rejects a plan with premium_stop None; invalidation level required by plan.

strategy_identity._causal_basis: FIRST-SIGHT columns only. Mechanical columns are EXCLUDED from this package: opening-bar mechanical 1R = 96% is a known gap artifact (audit 09-16).
strategy_identity._formula_basis: alert_ranker/coverage_observer.py classify_window(): trigger = previous bar high (LONG) / low (SHORT), invalidation = opposite; family via strategy/strat_classifier.py _is_212_reversal (2D-1-2U / 2U-1-2D). Both files hashed in underlying_manifest.json at HEAD.
strategy_identity._parity_basis: No 212R replay exists (options_manager/replay = strat_212 continuation only).
strategy_identity._target_basis: NO target exists. Observer horizon = session close; 1R/2R are hit-rate probes, not a target rule.
strategy_identity._timeframe_basis: 30m RTH bars, first-sight = bar close + ~17.9 min (audit-verified causal).

validation._expectancy_basis: No option P&L exists. Underlying first-sight mean final R = +0.244 (n=77) is NOT an option expectancy and is NOT after costs.
validation._sample_basis: prospective_validation.py PERSISTING rule: >=30 prospective episodes, >=3 sessions, both directions, ex-opening first-sight diff >= +5pp (pre-registered 09-16 19:30Z). NOTE: this is an EPISODE rule, not a resolved-option-fill rule.
validation._walk_forward_basis: prospective 212R ex-opening first-sight 1R 35.0% vs baseline 39.3% (-4.3pp, n=21) = INSUFFICIENT PROSPECTIVE SAMPLE; excess did not persist in the 2 sessions observed.
validation._window_basis: 5 retrospective sessions (09-09..09-15) + 2 prospective (09-16/17). Not months. Retro window was used for discovery, so it is not untouched.

cells._cell_basis: FAMILY_SUMMARY_EX_OPENING.csv row STRAT_212_REVERSAL. resolved_fills = 0 because no option contract was ever selected or filled for any 212R episode.
